# ENCE and MICE - C Implementation Weak Scaling Plots

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
tag <- "C_weak"
results_file <- sprintf("section_4_2_ENCE_MICE_weak_scaling_%s.rds", tag)

scaling <- readRDS(results_file)
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions, message=FALSE}
report_metrics <- function(true, pred, method_name, elapsed) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - true)^2))
  cat(method_name, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Time:  ", round(elapsed, 2), "seconds\n")
  cat("RMSE:  ", rmse, "\n")
  cat("Bias %:", sum(pred - true) / sum(true) * 100, "\n")
  cat("R2:    ", 1 - sum((pred - true)^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2), "\n")
  cat("SRMSE: ", rmse / mean(true), "\n\n")
}

plot_obs_pred <- function(observed, predicted, method_name = "Method") {
  op <- par(pty = "s")
  on.exit(par(op))
  lims <- range(c(observed, predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(observed, predicted,
       xlim = lims, ylim = lims,
       xlab = "Observed", ylab = "Predicted",
       main = paste(method_name, ": Observed vs Predicted"),
       pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.12))
  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  grid()
}
```

## Unpack

```{r unpack, results='hold'}
meta <- scaling$meta
cat("Section 4.2.2 Weak Scaling\n")
cat("cutoff:", meta$cutoff, " K:", meta$K, " seed:", meta$seed,
    " stations available:", meta$n_stations, " observed (largest run):", meta$n_observed,
    " n_years:", length(meta$years),
    " years:", paste(meta$years, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
cat("description:", meta$description, "\n")
cat("run_time:   ", format(meta$run_time), "\n")
cat("hostname:   ", meta$hostname, " job:", meta$slurm_job_id,
    " nodelist:", meta$slurm_nodelist, "\n")
cat("R version:  ", meta$r_version, "\n")
cat("thread_grid:         ", meta$thread_grid, "\n")
cat("n_avail:             ", meta$n_avail, "\n")
cat("stations_per_thread: ", meta$stations_per_thread, "\n")
cat("station_order length:", length(meta$station_order), "\n\n")

thread_grid <- meta$thread_grid
n_stations_used <- meta$stations_per_thread * thread_grid

true_y    <- scaling$true_y
ENCE_y    <- scaling$ENCE_y
MICE_y    <- scaling$MICE_y
ENCE_time <- scaling$ENCE_time
MICE_time <- scaling$MICE_time
ENCE_time_mat <- scaling$ENCE_time_mat
MICE_time_mat <- scaling$MICE_time_mat
ENCE_rmse <- scaling$ENCE_rmse
ENCE_val  <- scaling$ENCE_val
ENCE_rmse_list <- scaling$ENCE_rmse_list
ENCE_val_list  <- scaling$ENCE_val_list
MICE_rmse_list <- scaling$MICE_rmse_list
ENCE_rmse_by_thread <- scaling$ENCE_rmse_by_thread
MICE_rmse_by_thread <- scaling$MICE_rmse_by_thread
```

```{r metrics, results='hold'}
report_metrics(true_y, ENCE_y, sprintf("ENCE (1 thread, %d stations)", n_stations_used[1]), ENCE_time["1"])
report_metrics(true_y, MICE_y, sprintf("MICE (1 thread, %d stations)", n_stations_used[1]), MICE_time["1"])
```

## Timings

```{r timings, results='hold'}
cat("Stations used per thread count:\n")
print(setNames(n_stations_used, thread_grid))

cat("\nCumulative wall time (s), summed over", meta$K, "folds:\n")
print(rbind(ENCE = round(ENCE_time, 2), MICE = round(MICE_time, 2)))

cat("\nPer-fold wall time, ENCE (rows = folds, cols = threads):\n")
print(round(ENCE_time_mat, 2))
cat("\nPer-fold wall time, MICE (rows = folds, cols = threads):\n")
print(round(MICE_time_mat, 2))

ENCE_mean <- colMeans(ENCE_time_mat)
ENCE_sd   <- apply(ENCE_time_mat, 2, sd)
MICE_mean <- colMeans(MICE_time_mat)
MICE_sd   <- apply(MICE_time_mat, 2, sd)

cat("\nENCE mean +/- sd per thread count:\n")
print(rbind(mean = round(ENCE_mean, 2), sd = round(ENCE_sd, 2)))
cat("\nMICE mean +/- sd per thread count:\n")
print(rbind(mean = round(MICE_mean, 2), sd = round(MICE_sd, 2)))
```

```{r weak_efficiency, results='hold'}
ENCE_weak_eff_mat <- ENCE_time_mat[, 1] / ENCE_time_mat
MICE_weak_eff_mat <- MICE_time_mat[, 1] / MICE_time_mat

ENCE_weak_eff_mean <- colMeans(ENCE_weak_eff_mat)
ENCE_weak_eff_sd   <- apply(ENCE_weak_eff_mat, 2, sd)
MICE_weak_eff_mean <- colMeans(MICE_weak_eff_mat)
MICE_weak_eff_sd   <- apply(MICE_weak_eff_mat, 2, sd)

cat("ENCE weak scaling efficiency (T(1)/T(n)), mean +/- sd:\n")
print(rbind(mean = round(ENCE_weak_eff_mean, 2), sd = round(ENCE_weak_eff_sd, 2)))
cat("\nMICE weak scaling efficiency (T(1)/T(n)), mean +/- sd:\n")
print(rbind(mean = round(MICE_weak_eff_mean, 2), sd = round(MICE_weak_eff_sd, 2)))
```

## Accuracy across thread counts / problem sizes

```{r rmse_by_thread, results='hold'}
cat("Final RMSE by thread count / station subset size.\n")
cat("Unlike strong scaling, differences here can reflect genuine problem-size/station-subset\n")
cat("changes, not purely thread-count numerics.\n\n")
print(rbind(ENCE = round(ENCE_rmse_by_thread, 6), MICE = round(MICE_rmse_by_thread, 6)))
```

## Scatterplots

```{r scatterplots, results='hold'}
plot_obs_pred(true_y, ENCE_y, sprintf("ENCE (1 thread, %d stations)", n_stations_used[1]))
plot_obs_pred(true_y, MICE_y, sprintf("MICE (1 thread, %d stations)", n_stations_used[1]))
```

## Convergence (1 thread / smallest subset run)

```{r ence_convergence_plot, results='hold'}
col_rmse <- "#234ec2"
col_val  <- "#c20d0d"

plot(ENCE_rmse, type = "b", col = col_rmse, pch = 15,
     xlab = "Cycle", ylab = "Internal RMSE (between cycles)",
     main = "ENCE Convergence (1 thread, smallest subset)")
grid()

plot(ENCE_val, type = "b", col = col_val, pch = 17,
     xlab = "Cycle", ylab = "Validation RMSE (masked cells)",
     main = "ENCE Validation RMSE (1 thread, smallest subset)")
grid()
```

```{r mice_histories, results='hold'}
cat("MICE rmse_histories (1 thread, smallest subset): ", length(MICE_rmse_list), "folds x",
    length(MICE_rmse_list[[1]]), "imputations (m)\n\n")
cat("Fold 1:\n"); print(MICE_rmse_list[[1]])
```

## Weak Scaling Plots

```{r scaling_time_plot, results='hold'}
col_ence <- "#eb7500"
col_mice <- "#7008d1"

plot(thread_grid, ENCE_mean, type = "b", col = col_ence, pch = 15,
     ylim = range(c(ENCE_mean - ENCE_sd, ENCE_mean + ENCE_sd, 0)),
     xlab = "Threads (stations scaled proportionally)", ylab = "Wall time (s)",
     main = "Weak Scaling: ENCE")
arrows(thread_grid, ENCE_mean - ENCE_sd, thread_grid, ENCE_mean + ENCE_sd,
       angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = col_ence)
grid()

plot(thread_grid, MICE_mean, type = "b", col = col_mice, pch = 17,
     ylim = range(c(MICE_mean - MICE_sd, MICE_mean + MICE_sd, 0)),
     xlab = "Threads (stations scaled proportionally)", ylab = "Wall time (s)",
     main = "Weak Scaling: MICE")
arrows(thread_grid, MICE_mean - MICE_sd, thread_grid, MICE_mean + MICE_sd,
       angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = col_mice)
grid()
```

```{r scaling_efficiency_plot, results='hold'}
plot(thread_grid, ENCE_weak_eff_mean, type = "b", col = col_ence, pch = 15,
     ylim = c(0, 1.1),
     xlab = "Threads (stations scaled proportionally)", ylab = "Weak scaling efficiency",
     main = "Weak Scaling Efficiency: ENCE vs MICE")
arrows(thread_grid, ENCE_weak_eff_mean - ENCE_weak_eff_sd, thread_grid, ENCE_weak_eff_mean + ENCE_weak_eff_sd,
       angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = col_ence)
lines(thread_grid, MICE_weak_eff_mean, type = "b", col = col_mice, pch = 17)
arrows(thread_grid, MICE_weak_eff_mean - MICE_weak_eff_sd, thread_grid, MICE_weak_eff_mean + MICE_weak_eff_sd,
       angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05, col = col_mice)
abline(h = 1, col = "grey40", lty = 2)
grid()
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("ENCE", "MICE", "Ideal"),
       col = c(col_ence, col_mice, "grey40"), pch = c(15, 17, NA), lty = c(1, 1, 2))
```
